The dominant gesture is weak in the front and opposite views, while the top view suggests several intersecting pieces without a strong primary mass or legible void. The form does not rely entirely on conventional stair stepping, but its layered silhouette remains fragmented and the apparent crossings create collision ambiguity across views. The diagonal and shifted-platform precedent signals are present only as a faint geometric association.
warnings: The diagonal bridge is not legible as a distinct connecting volume across all views.
Several thin surface pieces overlap without a clear primary body, creating collision ambiguity.
No meaningful courtyard, undercut, or publicly legible open-ground void is visible.
